label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived from java.util.Random().nextFloat() (L72-73), which is used as a remember-me cookie value (L95) and session attribute (L100). Weak RNG feeding security-sensitive tokens constitutes a real vulnerability per policy. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is rememberMe.getValue() which equals rememberMeKey, sourced from server-generated Random.nextFloat() (L72-73), not from user-controlled input on this execution path. The cookie is freshly created and added to the response, so its value is not attacker-controlled in this request cycle. Case TP driven by Alert 1.
